title: 🍺 Feldschlösschen Detective
description: Aargau is known for one of the most famous beers in Switzerland.
instructions:
Find three different Feldschlösschen products.
Without looking at the labels, one teammate must correctly identify all three flavours by taste alone (a blind taste test).
The beers must then be correctly matched to their labels.

If you fail, you can try again after waiting 10 minutes.

title: Appenzeller Cheese Whiz
description: Appenzell is known for its famous Swiss cheese.
instructions:
Find three different cheeses that are officially branded as Appenzeller.
Before checking the labels, the team must correctly predict which cheese is which, based only on appearance, smell, or taste. Examples might include different ages or varieties of Appenzeller.

Rules:
The team must identify three different Appenzeller-branded cheeses.
The cheeses must be correctly matched to their labels (a blind taste test).

If you fail, you can try again after waiting 10 minutes.

title: Appenzell Architecture Tour
description: Appenzell's traditional houses are known for their decorative artwork and painted details. Seek out three fine examples.
instructions:
For each building:
Take a photo showing the decorative feature.
Identify what type of feature it is (for example: painted façade, carved wooden detail, traditional sign, window decoration, or other Appenzell-style ornament).
Explain briefly why you think it represents traditional Appenzell architecture.
Guess what the artwork represents, and check whether you can find any information about its meaning.

Rules:
The three buildings must be at least 250 metres apart.
The same building cannot be used more than once.
The decorative feature must be a permanent part of the building, not a temporary poster, advertisement, or decoration.

Complete the challenge by finding three different decorated buildings.

title: Bear Imitator
description: Bern is famous for its bears. Your mission is to discover the bears hiding throughout the canton.
instructions:
Find bears in three different locations in the canton of Bern.
For each bear:
Take a photo showing the bear symbol, statue, artwork, or other representation.
Identify where you found it.
Strike a different bear pose or imitation inspired by each one.

The three bears must come from different towns, villages, or cities within the canton. You cannot use the same one more than once.

title: Ring of Fire
description: Basel-Land is home to Chienbäse, one of Switzerland's largest annual festivals, which celebrates the end of winter with huge blazing bundles of brushwood.
instructions:
Your team must travel to Liestal and find a public fireplace, then hold a pretend ceremony: act out lighting a fire and make your wishes for the end of winter. (Normally there would be a real fire, but open flames are banned during the drought.)
The ceremony must last at least 5 minutes.
Film it and share the video with the opposing team.

title: Bonjour! Grüezi! Guten Tag!
description: Basel sits at the meeting point of Switzerland, Germany, and France. Explore Basel's unique border culture through its languages.
instructions:
Take a photo of three examples of greetings used in the Basel area:
one greeting in Swiss German;
one greeting in French;
one greeting in standard German.

The greetings can be found on public signs, advertisements, menus, shop displays, transport information, or other public sources.
Each source must be at least 250 metres from the others.
Photos must clearly show the language being used.

title: Time Traveler
description: Fribourg combines medieval history with modern life. Find clues that show how the city has changed over time.
instructions:
Find three objects, buildings, or features from medieval Fribourg that ChatGPT judges to be at least 500 years old.
Then find one modern object that ChatGPT judges to be less than 1 year old. This cannot be anything perishable or edible; it must be a "permanent" object.

title: Geneva Peace Summit
description: Geneva is one of the world's most important centres for international diplomacy, peace, and global cooperation.
instructions:
Complete a Geneva international-relations trivia challenge.
The Game Master generates three age-appropriate questions using the following prompt:

"Create three multiple-choice (A–D) trivia questions suitable for a knowledgeable 12-year-old about Geneva's role in international relations. Questions may relate to the United Nations, international organisations, diplomacy, peace agreements, humanitarian work, or major historical events connected to Geneva. Questions should require knowledge and reasoning but not specialist expertise."

The team must answer all three correctly. If you do not, you must wait at least 15 minutes before trying again.

title: The Green Cheese Roll
description: Glarus is home to Schabziger, one of Switzerland's most distinctive cheeses. Prove your cheese skills with a rolling challenge inspired by the famous cheese games of the world.
instructions:
Find a piece of Schabziger or another suitable Glarus cheese product. The cheese cannot cost more than 10 CHF in total.
Build a cheese-rolling course on a safe, publicly accessible area with a slight slope.

The team must:
place the cheese at the starting point;
roll the cheese down the course. The cheese must roll at least 10m before stopping. If it does not, you must wait 10 minutes before trying again.

title: Rätoromanisch Translator
description: Graubünden is Switzerland's most linguistically diverse canton and home to Rätoromanisch, one of Switzerland's national languages. Explore the language hidden in the landscape.

title: Freiberger Horse Creator
description: The Franches-Montagnes (Freiberger) horse is one of Switzerland's most famous breeds and is strongly connected to Jura. Create your own perfect Freiberger horse.

title: Lucerne Postcard Challenge
description: Lucerne is famous for its combination of lake, mountains, and iconic Swiss scenery. Create the perfect Lucerne postcard.

title: Watch Factory Manager
description: Neuchâtel is part of Switzerland's historic watchmaking region. Become one with the watch.
instructions:
One teammate claps once. A second teammate must clap as close as possible to 15 seconds later.
Using a timer, the two claps must be between 14.5 and 15.5 seconds apart.
You may practise this up to 3 times before your attempt. If you fail, you must wait at least 10 minutes before trying again.

title: Champion's Podium
description: Nidwalden is home to one of Switzerland's greatest skiers, Marco Odermatt. Create your own championship ceremony wherever you are.

title: Lake Sarnen Animal Lover
description: Lake Sarnen is home to many animals. Explore its shores and discover the wildlife connected to Obwalden.
instructions:
Find and photograph five different animals around Lake Sarnen.
The animals can include:
birds;
insects;
mammals;
or other visible wildlife.

Rules:
The animals must be real, not pictures, statues, signs, or decorations.
Each animal must be different.
They must be found within 50m of the lake (or on the lake, of course).

Complete the challenge by showing five different animal photos.

title: St. Gallen Thing Knower
description: St. Gallen has a unique history shaped by its abbey, textiles, and traditions. Test your knowledge of the canton with a local trivia challenge.
instructions:
Travel to a location in St. Gallen and complete a local trivia challenge.
Ask ChatGPT to generate three questions using the following prompt:

"Create three multiple-choice (A–D) trivia questions about the canton of St. Gallen suitable for a family game. Questions should cover local history, geography, culture, famous people, traditions, landmarks, or unique facts about St. Gallen. The questions should be challenging but solvable by a knowledgeable 12-year-old."

The team must answer all three correctly. If an answer is wrong, the team must wait 15 minutes before trying again.

title: Munot Messenger
description: The Munot fortress has watched over Schaffhausen for centuries. Send a secret message like a medieval messenger, using only symbols.
instructions:
One team member creates a message using only emojis. The message must contain at least five emojis and form a complete sentence, including a noun and a verb. It should represent a warning, announcement, or instruction that could have been sent from the Munot fortress.
The other team member must guess the exact sentence.
You cannot coordinate at all beforehand. If the guess is wrong, the team must wait 15 minutes before trying again.

title: The Rule of 11
description: Solothurn has a famous connection to the number 11. Explore the city and find examples where the number appears.

title: Morgarten History Reenactment
description: Schwyz played a central role in the early history of Switzerland. Travel to the site of the Battle of Morgarten and recreate a moment from Swiss history.
instructions:
Travel to the Morgarten battlefield area in Schwyz.
Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/DqiVqiQbsRpA5aX48

At the location:
Find a historical marker, monument, or information board connected to the Battle of Morgarten.
Take a photo of your team reenacting a scene inspired by the battle.
The photo must clearly show:
the historical location;
your team's reenactment;
a connection to the Battle of Morgarten.

Your team must also explain:
who fought in the battle;
why Morgarten is important in Swiss history.

title: Apple of my eye
description: Thurgau is known as the "apple canton" of Switzerland. Explore its most famous fruit through an observation challenge.

title: Ticino Translation Challenge
description: Ticino is Switzerland's Italian-speaking canton. Test your language skills by translating an Italian sentence into three more languages.
instructions:
Complete an Italian translation challenge.
Use the following prompt in ChatGPT to generate one Italian sentence:

"Create one medium-difficulty sentence in Italian. The sentence should be suitable for a family language challenge and should include enough vocabulary and grammar to require real translation, but should not use rare words or complex grammar."

The team must translate the sentence into:
English;
German;
French.

Put your translations back into ChatGPT for confirmation. You cannot use any other language tools. If all three are not judged correct, you must wait 10 minutes before trying again.

title: Birthplace of Switzerland
description: Uri is connected to the founding story of Switzerland. Travel to one of the country's most famous historical locations.
instructions:
Travel to the Rütli meadow.
At the location, take a photo recreating the legendary oath of the Swiss Confederates.

title: Olympic Challenge
description: Lausanne is home to the International Olympic Committee and is known as the Olympic Capital. Test your Olympic knowledge in the city where the modern Olympic movement is run.
instructions:
Travel to the International Olympic Committee headquarters or the Olympic Museum area in Lausanne.
Complete an Olympic trivia challenge. Ask ChatGPT to generate five questions using the following prompt:

"Create five family-friendly multiple-choice (A–D) trivia questions about the Olympic Games, suitable for a 12-year-old. Questions should include Olympic history, famous athletes, host cities, symbols, traditions, or facts connected to the International Olympic Committee. At least two questions should relate specifically to Lausanne or the IOC."

The team must answer all five correctly. If not, you must wait 10 minutes before trying again. You cannot search or use any other tools to answer.

title: Matterhorn Expedition
description: Valais is home to Switzerland's most famous mountain, the Matterhorn. Reach one of the most iconic viewpoints in Switzerland.
instructions:
Travel to a location in Valais where the Matterhorn is visible.
Complete the challenge by taking a photo showing:
your team;
the Matterhorn.

Send the photo to the opposing team.

title: Cherry I Love you Baby
description: Zug is famous for its cherries and the iconic Zuger Kirschtorte.
instructions:
Buy a box of cherries (at least 200g).
Before counting, predict how many cherries are in the box. You may not research anything about cherry weights beforehand.
Count the actual number. Your prediction must be within 15% of the real total. If you are wrong, buy a new box and try again.
If you predict within 15%, complete the challenge by eating the whole box of cherries.

title: Zürich Transit Master
description: Canton Zürich has one of Switzerland's most extensive public transport networks. Master the canton's many forms of transport.
